hints.title: Find Mismatch Indices
hints.text: Identify all indices i where characters s1[i] and s2[i] differ.

hints.title: Check Mismatch Count
hints.text: If mismatch count is 0, they are already equal. If mismatch count is not 2, a single swap cannot fix it.

hints.title: Verify Crossed Match
hints.text: If mismatch indices are i and j, check whether s1[i] == s2[j] and s1[j] == s2[i].

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all O(n^2) swaps takes quadratic time when a single linear pass suffices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space tracking up to two mismatch indices runs in linear O(n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks that mismatch count is either 0 or exactly 2 with matching crossed characters.
